title: Instant E-PAN User Manual
section: 2. Pre-requisites for availing this service • Individual who has not been allotted a PAN   • Valid Aadhaar and mobile number linked to Aadhaar and access to Digi locker   • User not a minor as on date of request; and  #### 3. Step-by-Step Guide  #### 3.1 Generate New e-PAN **Step 1:** Go to the e-Filing portal homepage.   **Step 2:** On the ‘e-PAN’ page, click**‘Get New e-PAN’.**  **Step 3:** On the Get New e-PAN page, confirm all four eligibility declaration checkboxes and also, checkbox for declaration for consent for the generation of a new PAN based on Digi Locker data and Aadhaar e-KYC details, after confirming all check boxes Continue button will enable. click ‘Continue’.   **Step 5:** Enter the Aadhaar / VID number, captcha code and click Next.  **Please Note:** VID (Virtual ID) is a temporary 16-digit number from UIDAI you can use instead of your Aadhaar number for authentication/e-KYC. It’s valid for 1 day and you can regenerate it anytime free of cost. **To get it:**   •⁠ ⁠Online: UIDAI website → Virtual ID option → enter Aadhaar number + captcha → OTP to registered mobile → VID generated instantly   •⁠ SMS: Send ⁠ GVID ⁠ + last 4 digits of Aadhaar (e.g., ⁠ GVID 1234 ⁠) to 1947 from your registered mobile **Step 6:** Enter the OTP sent to the mobile number registered with Aadhaar and click continue.  **Step 7:** Enter your 6-digit security PIN and click Continue.  **Please Note:** DigiLocker Security PIN is a 6-digit code you set when you first registered with DigiLocker — it’s separate from your Aadhaar number, OTP, or password, and it’s used specifically to log in quickly without needing an OTP each time. **If you don’t remember PIN:** Just click “Forgot security PIN?” → verify via OTP sent to your registered mobile/email → set a new 6-digit PIN → use it to log in. **Step 8:** Select the documents to be shared with Income Tax Department for proof of date of birth. Click Allow  **Note:** • You can select multiple documents and also you can edit the consent validity date.  • If multiple documents are selected, documents will be sorted alphabetically, and the first document will be used as proof of DOB  **Step 9:** On the Aadhaar validation page, enter the Aadhaar Number for PAN allotment and click generate OTP.
